propositions: Pass-2 verify rejects every verification index as unexpected when Pass-1 produces zero findings, causing all findings to degrade to INDETERMINATE despite correct gate verdict
Empty batch synthesis sends a verify request with no indices offered, but the verifier responds with indices 0..N-1 as if findings existed, creating an index-basis mismatch at decide
The root cause is verify_instructions() returning an imperative string for empty batch instead of an empty-batch-specific contract, forcing downstream index reshape to reject all returned indices
INDETERMINATE findings from Pass-2 degradation cannot cause a gate BLOCK and are silently absorbed into PASS verdict when any advisory surfaces, masking the verification failure
The defect affected 43 stored REVIEW_RESULT events on the tickets branch; all had zero LLM findings and correct PASS verdict, so no previously-signed reviews lost findings
Fix deploys EMPTY_BATCH_INSTRUCTIONS contract for empty batches at the verify kernel seam, mirroring the pattern already used in prerequisite_workflow_ops, and is validated by deterministic unit test
